about: Labelled test vectors for the Guardian message-safety baseline (docs/spec/03_Backend.md §7.7, FR-110). Every client port (iOS, Android, web) and every model that replaces a rule must pass all of them. 'expect' lists the signals that must fire; benign messages must fire none.
